note: The share of repositories that received a push in the last 30 days (active) versus those that did not (inactive).
methodology: List the organisation's repositories with their last-push timestamp.
Classify each repository by whether it received a push in the last 30 days.
Count repositories in each state. Pushes are counted, not merged PRs.
population: Repositories with a push in the 30 days before collection versus other repositories.
